nodes.name: INT8 MAC
nodes.behavior: Use synchronous active-high reset to clear accumulator and output valid. pair_data packs signed INT8 operands a in bits [15:8] and b in bits [7:0]. On an input valid/ready handshake, add their signed product to the signed INT32 accumulator, modulo 2^32, and present the new accumulator on acc_data with valid high after the clock edge. pair_data_ready is !acc_data_valid || acc_data_ready. Hold output data/valid during backpressure. An output transfer without a new input clears valid; simultaneous output and input transfers replace the consumed result. Reset has priority. No implicit initial values.
nodes.test_expectations: Future behavioral tests: mixed-sign products, repeated accumulation, reset, stalls, simultaneous transfers, and INT32 wraparound. These tests are not executed in M2-A.

nodes.name: Result Sink
nodes.behavior: On reset clear count; otherwise keep data_in_ready high and increment a 32-bit internal count on each valid/ready transfer. This adjacent node is input data only; no RTL candidate is generated for it in the recorded M2-A run.
nodes.test_expectations: Future test: count accepted MAC results. Not executed.

edges.behavior: Transfer the signed 32-bit accumulated result when valid and ready are high; hold data and valid while stalled. Both endpoints share clk and synchronous active-high rst.
